agent_notes: No source anywhere (web, news, video, social, image, book, archive, gov, legal) directly names Kachrana/कचराणा/कचराना in connection with Bikaner, Lunkaransar or Mahajan. Modern census village lists for Lunkaransar tehsil (census2011.co.in, 125 villages) and GeoNames contain no entry for Kachrana or close spelling variants (Kuchrana, Kachhrana, Kachrasar) - consistent with it being an acquired/de-listed village rather than a mapping error, but this is negative evidence only, not confirmation. Two 1874/1962 Bikaner state gazetteers (archive.org, full text checked) also show no occurrence. Best remaining leads: (1) a 1987 Lok Sabha unstarred question PDF specifically titled 'Mahajan Field Firing Range in Rajasthan' that likely lists acquired village names but could not be read past its catalog page; (2) three Rajasthan Patrika human-interest pieces on the 1984-85 displacement of the '34 villages' that name several other acquired villages (Bhojrasar, Kumbhana, Motlai, Khaniser, Thoiya, Maneran, Duder, Khajuwala, Dantur/Dantaur, Pugal, Mohangadh, Nachna) but do not mention Kachrana - a human should check if later Patrika/Bhaskar pieces on the same beat (reporters Hari Singh, Jay Kumar Bhati, Dinesh Kumar Swami) ever add it. Spellings tried: Kachrana, कचराणा, कचराना, Kachrana Mahajan, Kachrana Lunkaransar/Loonkaransar. All returned nothing name-specific; recommend re-trying 'Kachhrana', 'Kanchrana', 'Kacharwada' next.
